name: Bapst Berry Patch
tagline: Growing strawberries for two decades at Bapst Berry Patch – Ohio Ag Net
description: Bapst Berry Patch grows Strawberries in Beaver, OH. The farm is working, and its seasons run through spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
